newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms as funds sought for T-bill buying.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms as funds sought for T-bill buying.

text.p: The rouble firmed in lively trading on Wednesday after an early speculative dip and dealers said banks were seeking funds to invest in government debt.
roubles/dollar Jan 22 midday Jan 22 early Jan 21 close
Dealers said the rouble eased as banks expected its supply to grow after they had set aside funds for today's auctions. But the rouble shortage persisted and the rate firmed.
Today the central bank is auctioning seven trillion roubles of an additional tranche of six-month Treasury bills and three trillion roubles of an additional tranche of OFZ bonds.

"The dollar rose in the morning as funds were expected from the T-bill market, but then eased as forecasts were not confirmed or somebody was seeking extra roubles to invest in T-bills (on Thursday)," one dealer said.
Another dealer said further rate changes were unlikely today, with cost of roubles remaining relatively high.
